reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses a small-business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, practical voice. Strictly adheres to the zero-CTA rule and human approval principles.
reasons.clarity: Clear logical structure defining control boundaries, distinguishing AI drafting from human sign-off, and delivering an immediate, unambiguous main point.

reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately qualifies both internal demos as self-contained tests with synthetic data rather than production systems or customer case studies.
